blocks.heading: Banking and Financial Services (BofA and Wells Fargo)
paragraphs: Charlotte is the US's second-largest banking city after New York — Bank of America and Wells Fargo together employ more than 25,000 in Charlotte:

Bank of America (Charlotte HQ): BofA's Charlotte headquarters is the operational and technology center for the US's second-largest bank: Consumer credit risk ML for BofA's 68 million consumer and small business clients. Erica (BofA's AI assistant) ecosystem extensions and analytics ML. Regulatory capital and CCAR stress testing ML for BofA's massive balance sheet.

Wells Fargo (Charlotte major operations): Wells Fargo employs 10,000+ in Charlotte across wholesale banking, mortgage, and technology: Commercial loan risk analytics for Wells Fargo's large corporate and real estate lending portfolios. Mortgage origination and servicing analytics for one of the US's largest mortgage servicers. Fraud detection and financial crime analytics for Wells Fargo's AML program.
Cost: $60,000–$170,000 | Timeline: 12–26 weeks | SR 11-7, OCC, CCAR

blocks.heading: Utilities and Energy (Duke Energy)
paragraphs: Duke Energy (Charlotte HQ) is the largest US electric utility by rate base — serving 8+ million electric customers across the Southeast and Midwest:
Grid reliability ML: Outage prediction, equipment failure forecasting, and storm restoration analytics for Duke's massive transmission and distribution network.
Renewable energy integration: Solar and wind generation forecasting for Duke's rapidly expanding renewable portfolio in the Carolinas.
Customer analytics: Energy efficiency program targeting, demand response enrollment prediction, and electric vehicle adoption forecasting for Duke's large residential and commercial customer base.
Cost: $45,000–$125,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks | NERC, FERC, NCUC context

blocks.heading: Healthcare (Advocate Health / Atrium)
paragraphs: Atrium Health (now merged with Advocate Health Care, forming the US's 5th-largest nonprofit health system):
HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Atrium's large Epic-integrated Carolinas network.
Population health analytics for North Carolina's and South Carolina's Medicaid managed care programs.
Clinical research AI for Atrium's growing academic programs at Wake Forest University School of Medicine (Charlotte campus).
Cost: $55,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA, NC Medicaid

blocks.heading: Motorsports Technology Analytics
paragraphs: Charlotte's Concord/Kannapolis suburb hosts most NASCAR team engineering operations — a unique AI market:
Race strategy analytics: ML for race simulation, pit stop timing optimization, and track-position strategy decisions for NASCAR Cup Series teams.
Vehicle telemetry ML: Real-time sensor data analytics from NASCAR cars' extensive telemetry for engineering teams.
Supply chain analytics for motorsports: Parts procurement and inventory management ML for the complex, time-critical spare parts supply chains that NASCAR teams manage.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | NASCAR context

sections.title: Charlotte's Technology Transformation
sections.description: Charlotte's technology community has diversified significantly beyond its banking roots.

blocks.heading: Charlotte's rise as a tech hub
paragraphs: NC State's research programs (Raleigh, 3 hours east) and UNC Charlotte's growing data science and computer science programs are creating a local AI talent pipeline that reduces Charlotte's historical dependence on recruiting from the coasts. The Charlotte region added over 15,000 technology jobs between 2019 and 2024 — one of the fastest rates among major Southeast cities.

blocks.heading: Red Ventures (Fort Mill SC, adjacent Charlotte)
paragraphs: Red Ventures is one of the largest private internet companies in the US — a Charlotte-area digital marketing and eCommerce platform that has built sophisticated data science and ML capabilities internally. The ML talent that has cycled through Red Ventures has seeded Charlotte's broader ML community.

blocks.heading: Truist Technology Center
paragraphs: Truist Financial's technology center in Charlotte combines the legacy SunTrust and BB&T technology organizations into one of the Southeast's largest banking technology employers. The Truist AI investment — particularly in credit risk, fraud, and digital banking ML — has raised Charlotte's financial services AI sophistication considerably.
